query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN protocol IS NULL OR protocol = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sans_protocole,
  SUM(CASE WHEN protocol IS NOT NULL AND protocol != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as avec_protocole
FROM recettes
